```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

This HTML report reproduces the written report stored in the repository's root `README.md` file. The report and its figures are maintained in the README so that the same scientific narrative is visible on GitHub and in the rendered document.

```{r include-readme, results='asis'}
readme_lines <- readLines("README.md", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)

# The HTML report is saved in report/, so adjust local figure paths
# from the README root-relative form to paths relative to report/.
readme_lines <- gsub(
  "!\\[([^]]*)\\]\\(results/figures/([^)]*)\\)",
  "![\\1](../results/figures/\\2)",
  readme_lines
)

cat(readme_lines, sep = "\n")
```
